facts: The Northumbria Mysteries is a detective drama series commissioned by BBC Daytime for BBC iPlayer and BBC One.
The series centres on an unlikely crime‑solving duo consisting of Joe Ruby and DI Rose O Connell.
Robson Green stars as Joe Ruby, an ex‑con who volunteers at a local priory.
Liz White plays the intellectual and ice‑cool Oxford‑educated DI Rose O Connell.
Gurjeet Singh stars as DS Raj Singh.
Simon Callow plays the Prior, Father David.
Filming for the series took place in locations including Alnwick and Rothbury.
Banijay Rights handles international distribution for the series.
Chris Gascoyne plays Ace Dawson in the drama.
